newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius CDS officially operational January end.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius CDS officially operational January end.

text.p: The electronic share settlement Central Depository System (CDS) at the Stock Exchange of Mauritius (SEM) will officially start operating at the end of January, a top industry official said on Thursday.
"The CDS will probably be officially operational on 27th or 28th of January," said the official who declined to be named.

The SEM CDS started operating on a mock basis in early January after the Mauritian government passed the Securities (Central Depository, Clearing and Settlement) bill in mid December, providing the necessary legal framework for the CDS operations.

The CDS is expected to boost trading at the SEM especially among foreign investors, by reducing the time needed to transfer share certificates from sellers to buyers and offering more safety to the process.
